scope: Small phase-owned LAN runner; no Phase 5 certification or Phase 10 release credit

cases.title: Identified intent and host stepping
cases.rationale: Duplicate or foreign intent breaks ownership and movement.
cases.setup: Build the restored five-project solution with strict analyzers.
actions: Execute named C# production-authority expectations with exact one-test report.
expected: Owned intent accepts without stepping; wrong owner, unready and replayed intent reject; solo/host/guest agree.
cases.reset: Fresh test state or invocation-owned headless processes; release only owned children, ports and profile roots.

cases.title: Host and one guest through ordinary main scene
cases.rationale: Actual native transport and input composition must work together.
cases.setup: Two separate owned pinned Godot processes use --headless and the ordinary project/main scene, fresh profile IDs and allocated UDP port.
actions: Synthetic native Enter activates Host session.
Synthetic native input opens Join LAN, fills manual address and activates Join address.
Wait for installed baseline and ready state.
Synthetic D press and release pass through native _Input and physical polling.
Observe guest movement and coherent matching publication on both peers.
Escape and Quit through ordinary input.
expected: Two distinct ready player/actor/binding owners in same session.
Guest cannot act before installed baseline; ack follows install.
Movement affects only the guest at host and guest.
Both owned processes exit zero within 60-second subject deadline.
cases.provenance: Synthetic native events; no physical input, rendering, timing, or physical LAN credit.
cases.reset: Fresh processes are required to prove independent host and guest native lifetimes; cleanup only owned children.
